builds.name: Reference: AP and conditional recovery
builds.goal: Reference for Vladimir: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A health/AP-converting sustain mage who times empowered Q and a charged area burst, using Pool to avoid retaliation. His health costs make offensive and defensive timing inseparable. Record empowered Q readiness, E health cost and Pool timing. His health/AP conversion does not recursively generate infinite stats; compare real survival and burst windows. AP first, then conditional Visage recovery, tests damage before death.
builds.summary: AP first, then conditional Visage recovery, tests damage before death.
testPlan: Kit question for Vladimir: Record empowered Q readiness, E health cost and Pool timing. His health/AP conversion does not recursively generate infinite stats; compare real survival and burst windows.

Start with the early core (Riftmaker, then AP or protection according to the fight) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Crimson Rush. Do not treat mana regeneration as Crimson Rush recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP first, then conditional Visage recovery, tests damage before death. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Visage is not efficient without useful healing/shields or an appropriate magic-damage threat.

The route fails Vladimir's stated kit question: Record empowered Q readiness, E health cost and Pool timing. His health/AP conversion does not recursively generate infinite stats; compare real survival and burst windows.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Visage is not efficient without useful healing/shields or an appropriate magic-damage threat.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Riftmaker, then AP or protection according to the fight. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Zhonya's Hourglass, Void Staff, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Crimson Rush. Do not treat mana regeneration as Crimson Rush recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to [(0.08) × Stat(12)] Health. While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%.

Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (0.015) × Stat(12) + (0.35) × AP] and [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.06) × Stat(12) + (0.8) × AP] magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by [40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60]% for 0.5 seconds.

Vladimir gains 1 Ability Power for every [30] bonus Health. He also gains [1.6] max Health per 1 Ability Power.

Bonus Ability Power: [((((1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (1.6) × ((-1) × AP))) × ((0.01) × (3.333))) × (1.06)]
Bonus Health: [(((1) × AP[statFormula=2] + ((0.01) × (3.333)) × ((-1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]))) × ((1.06) × (1.6))]

Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take [10]% increased damage from all sources for [4 / 4 / 4] seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage to all infected targets. Vladimir restores [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.7) × AP] Health if he hits a champion, and restores an additional [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.7) × AP) × (0.4)] Health for each champion beyond the first.

Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining [37.5]% decaying Move Speed for [1] second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by [40]%.

Vladimir deals [80 / 135 / 190 / 245 / 300 + (0.15) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage and restores [(80 / 135 / 190 / 245 / 300 + (0.15) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (0.3)] Health per enemy over the duration.

Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing [80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage and restoring [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 + (0.35) × AP] Health. After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 21, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 26, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])]% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for [2.5] seconds.

The empowered version of this Ability deals [(80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 + (0.6) × AP) × (1.85)] magic damage instead and restores an additional [(characterLevelInterpolation(30 → 200; raw flags preserved)) × (1)] plus [((5 + (0.04) × AP) × (0.01)) × (1)] missing Health.

builds.name: Health AP conversion drain
builds.summary: Test health ap conversion drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test health ap conversion drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Crimson Pact converts purchased bonus health to AP and AP to health without self-recursion; Heartsteel's earned health supports that conversion and E's max-health term. Riftmaker plus Visage rewards repeated Q/R healing, but health costs and weak wave pressure remain real.
testPlan: Required state: Earn measured Heartsteel stacks safely and preserve empowered Q timing.
Compare E damage and Q healing at recorded stacks and fixed missing health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Melee stack attempts expose Vladimir and delay normal burst AP.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Crimson Pact explicitly does not stack with itself; no infinite health/AP feedback loop.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Heartsteel, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Spirit Visage, Void Staff, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Empowered Q attack weave
builds.summary: Test empowered q attack weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test empowered q attack weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Empowered Transfusion multiplies Q damage by 1.85 during a 2.5-second window; Lich Bane adds one separate magic attack after Q while Nashor supports opportunistic attacks between cooldowns. Cosmic Drive helps reach and retreat from the attack without treating Pool as a damage shield.
testPlan: Required state: Arrive with empowered Q and a safe post-Q attack before pooling.
Compare Q-plus-one-attack trades and damage taken against spell-only trades.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Auto windup exposes Vladimir and weakens his normal E-R burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Q is an ability heal and cannot apply lifesteal or ordinary on-hit items by itself.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
